detail: Held-out industries in the commercial/diagnostic manifests currently share the same live environment_ref (ecommerce mall on localhost:8080). Running discovery against that single API with foreign OpenAPI docs would produce invalid cross-industry evidence. Distinct non-production held-out runtimes with working reset/observation are required before MEASURED held-out metrics.
required_next_step: Stand up >=3 distinct non-prod held-out industry targets with fixture reset.
